fun_facts: At Grimsley High School, Faizon Brandon threw for 6,956 yards and 82 touchdowns as a three-year starter. His team went 35-1 and won two state titles.
As a sophomore at Grimsley, Faizon Brandon threw for 3,026 yards and 36 touchdowns, with just three interceptions.
Faizon Brandon was named Tennessee’s starting quarterback as a true freshman.
In his college debut, Faizon Brandon became the first SEC player since Cam Newton to throw for three touchdowns and run for two in the same game.
Against LSU in 2026, Faizon Brandon scored on two fourth-quarter runs: one from 18 yards and another from 55 yards.

basis.reasoning: The cited ESPN passages state Faizon Brandon’s Grimsley career totals and team achievements, his sophomore-season passing stats, his appointment as Tennessee’s true-freshman starter, his historic five-touchdown college debut, and his two fourth-quarter touchdown runs against LSU.

excerpts: He threw for 6,956 yards and 82 touchdowns as a three-year starter at Grimsley High School, where Brandon posted a 35-1 record and led his program to a pair of state titles.

Monday has named true freshman [Faizon Brandon](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5158973/faizon-brandon) as the Volunteers' starting quarterback.

The 6-foot-4 pocket passer from Greensboro, North Carolina, signed with the Vols last December and spent the offseason competing with second-year quarterback [George MacIntyre](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5141571/george-macintyre) for the program's starting job.
citations.title: True freshman Faizon Brandon wins Tennessee starting QB job - ESPN

excerpts:
The 6-foot-4, 195-pound quarterback from Greensboro, North Carolina, threw for 3,026 yards and 36 touchdowns with three interceptions last fall as a sophomore at Grimsley High School. He stands as the first member of Tennessee's 2026 recruiting class, and leaves four-star pocket passer [Ryder Lyons](https://www.espn.com/college-sports/football/recruiting/player/_/id/256646/ryder-lyons) (No. 35 in the ESPN 300) as the cycle's last uncommitted top-10 pocket passer.

excerpts:
Updated: Nov 22, 2026, 01:55 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

KNOXVILLE, Tenn. -- — [Faizon Brandon](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5158973/faizon-brandon) had two long touchdown runs in the fourth quarter, Tennessee's stifling defense shut down LSU late, and the No. 9 Volunteers beat the Tigers 27-13 on Saturday to maintain their place in the College Football Playoff hunt.

Brandon, a freshman who shared time at quarterback with [George MacIntyre](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5141571/george-macintyre) , broke a 13-all tie with an 18-yard touchdown run, then added a 55-yard scoring scamper with just over 4 minutes remaining to put the game away.

MacIntyre was just 12 of 21 for 79 yards with a touchdown pass.
